subject: Film & Cinema
title: The Spec Script Market
description: One-minute skill: The Spec Script Market.

hook.text: In 1990, Shane Black sold The Last Boy Scout for $1.75 million. Screenwriters celebrated.

buildup.text: A spec script is written on speculation — no studio commission, no guarantee of sale.

discovery.text: The spec boom of the 1990s made screenwriters briefly powerful in Hollywood.

twist.text: Today, most films are based on existing properties. Original specs rarely sell.

climax.text: The spec market collapsed, but specs remain the primary way new writers get noticed.

punchline.text: Writing on hope is still the only way in.

quiz.question: What is a spec script?
options: A script written without a buyer, on speculation
